title: Family Resort: Pool, Outdoor Theater near Old Town
description:
Book your Scottsdale Oasis and spark a family adventure! Start with a hearty breakfast in the full kitchen, then unwind in the resort-style backyard: sizzle BBQ, roll putts, yard games, and kids splashing in the diving pool. As the sun dips, stream an outdoor movie while soaking in the hot tub or by the fire. Old Town is a quick ride away!

 The space 
LOCATION: MINUTES FROM BEST ACTIVITIES
Nestled in a quiet residential neighborhood, this home offers a peaceful retreat while keeping you close to the action. Take a morning stroll to nearby parks or make a quick 2-minute drive to the local convenience store for essentials. You're also just minutes from some of Scottsdale’s most iconic attractions:
• For family & kids: Scottsdale Museum of Contemporary Art (8 min), Botanical Garden (13 min), Camelback Mountain (14 min), OdySea Aquarium and Butterfly Wonderland (16 min).
• For parents and students: ASU Tempe Campus (15 min).
• For nightlife and shopping: Old Town Scottsdale (7 min), Scottsdale Fashion Square (9 min).
• For golfers: Camelback Golf Club (15 min), TPC Scottsdale (17 min).
• For spring training: Scottsdale Stadium (5 min), Sloan Park (6 min), Salt River Fields at Talking Stick (8 min), Hohokam Stadium (10 min), Tempe Diablo Stadium (14 min).
• For event-goers: WestWorld of Scottsdale (20 min).
**Drive times are estimates and may vary with traffic.

BACKYARD: YOUR PRIVATE RESORT
• Diving pool with a Baja step for toddlers and loungers for adults—perfect for family splash time and relaxing poolside chats.
• Private hot tub—ideal for a soothing soak under the stars after a fun-filled day. Always heated with no additional charge.
• Children’s playhouse with a chalkboard wall—keeps little adventurers entertained while adults unwind.
• Three-hole putting green with kid-size putters—friendly competition for all ages before dinner or after a swim.
• Shaded gazebo with propane and charcoal grills plus outdoor dining—great for sunset BBQs and family meals just steps from the pool.
• 120" outdoor theater with 4K projector and Dolby sound—movie nights and game-day gatherings under the open sky.
• Fire-pit lounge surrounded by cozy seating —perfect for s’mores, stories, and stargazing.

LIVING ROOM, KITCHEN & DINING ROOM: THE SOCIAL HUB
• 65″ 4K smart TV, leather sectional, and NEX Playground console—perfect for family game nights or friendly competitions.
• Chef’s kitchen featuring a 36″ induction stove, French-door fridge, pressure cooker, and plenty of cookware for home-cooked meals.
• Custom coffee bar with drip machine, K-Cup brewer, and a selection of organic teas to keep everyone energized.
• Dining area doubles as a game hub with board games and poker set for tournaments or after-dinner fun.
• Complimentary family essentials: kids’ tableware, high chair, booster, stroller, and pack-n-play provided.

BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS: REST AND RECHARGE
• All bedrooms have hotel-quality mattresses and linens, extra pillows, blackout drapes, and smart TVs.
• Two bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms—one with direct pool access for an early morning dip.
• All full baths stocked with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hotel-style hair dryers for added convenience.

FAMILY-ORIENTED FEATURES
Wi-Fi, air conditioning (smart thermostat), washer, dryer, and safety features (smoke/CO alarms, first aid kit) are available.

 Guest access 
Guests have access to the entire house and the backyard during their stay.

CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT
• Self check-in anytime after 4:00 PM. Custom code for the Yale smart lock will be provided 8 hours before check-in. Check-out is by 10:00 AM sharp. 
 • Early check-in or late check-out may be arranged in advance, subject to availability and an additional fee ($50 for one hour and $100 for two hours. 2 hours max).

PARKING
 • 6 vehicles max allowed: Driveway accommodates up to 4 vehicles; street parking available for 2 more directly in front of the home (first come, first served).
 • Do not park in front of neighboring homes
 • No RVs, trailers, or commercial vehicles without prior approval.

 Other things to note 
PET POLICY
 • Dogs only. Maximum of 2 dogs under 50 lbs each, with prior approval. $25 pet fee per pet, per night.
 • No pets on furniture or bedding. Please pick up waste immediately.
• Do not leave your pets unintended at home.
• Service animals are welcome and exempt from the fee.

POOL HEATING EXPECTATIONS
• Pool heat must be requested 24 hours in advance. The cost is $100/night, required for at least two consecutive nights ($200 minimum). 
• The maximum achievable temp is 85°F, and the heating effectiveness depends on outside ambient temperature, especially at night.

PROPANE TANK POLICY
 • 1 propane tank for the BBQ grill and 1 propane tank for the fire pit are included per stay. If you need extra propane during your stay, additional tanks are available for purchase at $100 per tank. Please message us to arrange this.
 • Always ensure flames are fully extinguished and valves are closed before leaving the area or going to bed.

HOT WATER EXPECTATION
 • Our home has an on-demand water heater, which might take a few minutes to deliver consistent hot water when multiple showers or faucets are in use. We recommend staggering the use of hot water (shower, washer, dishwasher) if needed. 

QUIET HOURS
 • 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM: Strict quiet hours enforced by city ordinance. Any sound that could disturb neighbors outside our property during those hours is prohibited
 • If the police are called, guests will be responsible for the fine (up to $2,500)

SECURITY
 • We have an exterior doorbell camera located at the front door that records upon motion. 
 • There are one exterior camera pointing at the driveway and two overlooking the backyard (pool and putting green areas). 
 • These are in place for guest safety and protection. Tampering may result in immediate eviction with no refund for unused nights.
 • There is an indoor sensor for noise and smoking detection. There are NO cameras inside the home. 
 • In compliance with Scottsdale's barrier requirements for short-term rental properties, this home is equipped with audible alarms (1) on the sliding door in the dining room, (2) on the French door in the primary bedroom, and (3) on the half-bath door to the backyard.

SMOKING
 • 100% smoke-free property. Violations will result in a $1,000 deep-cleaning fee.

OCCUPANCY
 • Only the number of guests included in your reservation are allowed on the property.
 • All outside vendors must be approved in advance by the host.
 • Unapproved additional guests may result in cancellation of your reservation with no refund.
 • Per city regulations, vacation rentals and short-term rentals may host a maximum of six adults, plus their related dependent children.

City of Scottsdale Vacation Rental License: #2044357
